notes: The page is simpler and less visually elaborate than Antigravity's desktop dashboard, but it looks finished and has a clear chart-table-source hierarchy.
Selecting 2023 changes the chart to a district bar comparison, the visible table and the downloaded rows without leaving stale change cards.
Turn 2 explicitly names Purnia at 76% as lowest and retains the non-causal caveat.
There are no invented performance bands, percentage/percentage-point errors, external assets, console errors or document-level overflow.
The pale editorial design has less immediate wow than Antigravity's dark KPI-rich page; later visual-family tests should improve variety without weakening the trusted result contract.
